summary: Completed mobile UI and backend verification for SafeTap AI. All requested login, dashboard, scan, invalid-credential, readiness, and API contract flows passed.

critical.issue: Endpoints return role-specific data without requiring or validating an authentication token; any caller can read investigator/admin metrics.

action_items: Add bearer-token/session validation and role authorization to investigator/admin overview and case APIs before production use.
Align frontend configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL variable, or explicitly document the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL convention used by the deployment.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL rather than the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current preview works because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is configured.
Logout Pressable has no testID and renders without a strict button role on web, reducing accessibility and automated-testability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (requested flows passed; role matrix and victim scan verified)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST scan case through the public scan API; no seed users or brands created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL tested at https://threat-verify-7.preview.emergentagent.com using 375x667 viewport. Invalid login stayed on login; victim scan of secure-paypal-check.com showed score 68, known/reported phishing, factors, and Recently Reported Threat. Investigator and Admin dashboards loaded with metrics/data sources.
rca_of_issue: The backend login endpoint issues a demo token, but overview routes do not accept an Authorization dependency or inspect that token. The frontend hides modules by local role state only, so direct API calls bypass the UI restriction. Threat feed and AI explanation are MOCKED deterministic fallback behavior because no live feed/key is configured.
